python3 << 'EOF'
# New York Internal Revenue Collections (in thousands)
ny_2010 = 200209720
ny_2015 = 269716999
ny_2024_actual = 384447300

# Calculate CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015
# Number of years = 5
n = 5
cagr = (ny_2015 / ny_2010) ** (1/n) - 1
print(f"CAGR (2010-2015): {cagr:.6f} or {cagr*100:.4f}%")

# Project FY 2024 using CAGR with FY 2015 as base
# Number of years from 2015 to 2024 = 9
years = 9
ny_2024_projected = ny_2015 * (1 + cagr) ** years
print(f"Projected FY 2024: {ny_2024_projected:,.0f}")
print(f"Actual FY 2024: {ny_2024_actual:,}")

# Calculate percentage difference relative to actual
# (Projected - Actual) / Actual * 100
percent_diff = (ny_2024_projected - ny_2024_actual) / ny_2024_actual * 100
print(f"Percentage difference: {percent_diff:.4f}%")
print(f"Percentage difference (rounded to hundredths): {percent_diff:.2f}%")
EOF
